planets.name: TOI-1883 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1883 with a 4.51-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1883 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1883. Its orbit and size follow Fukuda et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
